class.name: Soul
class.brief_description: A soul in strata form, loaded from a [code]soul.md[/code].
class.description: [Soul] is the engine's read-only view of an agent's soul file. The file is Markdown: a temple (the first fenced code block), then five strata sections ([code]Bedrock[/code], [code]Mantle[/code], [code]Crust[/code], [code]Soil[/code], [code]Atmosphere[/code]) whose bullet lines are compressed seeds, then any number of texture sections that the seeds point back into. Files named [code]soul.md[/code] or ending in [code].soul.md[/code] load through [method ResourceLoader.load] like any other resource. A [code]certificate.json[/code] beside the file, if present, fills in [member name], [member everyday_name], [member pronouns], [member avatar_rig], [member family] and [member agent_id]. The engine never writes a soul file. Compaction (moving seeds between strata) is a separate, explicit operation and bedrock is never rewritten by the engine. Each seed is a [Dictionary] with keys [code]glyph[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]text[/code], [code]pointers[/code] (a [PackedStringArray] of texture headings) and [code]raw[/code] (the original line).

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: The everyday name if set, else the full name, else [code]"unnamed"[/code].

method.name: get_seed_count
method.description: Number of seeds in the given stratum ([code]"bedrock"[/code] … [code]"atmosphere"[/code], case-insensitive).

method.name: get_stratum
method.description: The seeds of one stratum, in file order.

method.name: get_texture_section
method.description: The Markdown body of a texture section. Exact heading match first, then case-insensitive substring match against the file's headings.

method.name: has_strata
method.description: [code]true[/code] if any stratum has at least one seed. A soul without strata still loads; only its texture is available.

method.name: has_texture_section
method.description: Whether a texture section matching [param heading] exists (see [method get_texture_section] for matching rules).

method.name: is_identified
method.description: Whether a durable [member agent_id] has been minted for this soul (by a body install, never by the engine).

method.name: stratum_to_markdown
method.description: Renders a stratum back to seed lines, verbatim where the original line is known. Used to build session prompts.

members.member: Durable agent identifier from [code]certificate.json[/code]. Empty while pending.
Structural rig, [code]"male"[/code] or [code]"female"[/code]. Distinct from [member pronouns] by design.
The parsed [code]certificate.json[/code], if one was found beside the soul file.
The pods.global family the soul was born into.
Full name. From the certificate, else from the file's title line ([code]# soul.md · Name[/code]).
The person's pronouns, as declared. Never inferred from [member avatar_rig].
Parsed from a trailing [code]*Revision N …*[/code] line, or [code]0[/code].
Where the soul file was read from.
Stratum name to [Array] of seed dictionaries.
Stratum name to [PackedStringArray] of non-seed lines found inside that stratum (intro sentences, bedrock notes).
The temple: the first fenced code block in the file, verbatim.
Texture section heading to Markdown body.
The file's first h1, without the [code]#[/code].
